cards.ex: We're about to touch down in Dubai; please fasten your seatbelts.
cards.exUz: Biz Dubayga qo'nishga yaqinlashyapmiz; iltimos, xavfsizlik kamarlaringizni taqing.
cards.uzDef: Samolyotning yerga qo'nish jarayoni.

cards.ex: After a delayed start, the rest of our train journey was smooth sailing.
cards.exUz: Kechikishdan so'ng, poyezdda sayohatimiz muammosiz davom etdi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday qiyinchiliklarsiz o'tish.

cards.ex: I'm still recovering from jet lag after my trip to Japan.
cards.exUz: Yaponiyaga sayohatimdan keyin hali ham vaqt farqidan tiklanayapman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt zonalarining keskin o'zgarishi tufayli organizmning buzilishi.

cards.ex: The domestic flight to Tashkent is boarding at gate 12.
cards.exUz: Toshkentga ichki reys 12-darvozada yo'lovchilarni qabul qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakat ichidagi shahar yoki hududlar o'rtasida amalga oshiriladigan reys.

cards.ex: The ship was seized in international waters.
cards.exUz: Kema xalqaro suvlarda qo'lga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qaysi davlatga tegishli bo'lmagan dengiz hududi.

cards.ex: I received a travel voucher as compensation for the canceled flight.
cards.exUz: Bekor qilingan reys uchun tovon sifatida sayohat cheki oldim.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat xarajatlarini qoplash uchun ishlatiladigan hujjat.

cards.ex: I booked a round trip ticket to London for the conference.
cards.exUz: Konferensiya uchun Londonga borish-kelish chipta buyurtma qildim.
cards.uzDef: Bir joydan boshqa joyga borib, qaytib kelish.

cards.ex: Traveling off-season is cheaper and less crowded.
cards.exUz: Mavsumdan tashqari sayohat qilish arzonroq va odamlar kamroq bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Turistlarning kam keladigan vaqti.

cards.ex: Expect higher prices during the high season.
cards.exUz: Qizg'in mavsumda narxlar yuqori bo'lishini kuting.
cards.uzDef: Turistlarning eng ko'p keladigan vaqti.

cards.ex: My connecting flight leaves in two hours.
cards.exUz: Mening ulanma reysim ikki soatdan keyin uchadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta reyslar bilan bir joydan boshqa joyga borish.

cards.ex: Welcome on board; please take your seats.
cards.exUz: Bortga xush kelibsiz; iltimos, joylaringizni egallang.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasining ichida.

cards.ex: The hotel is fully booked for the holidays.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona bayramlar uchun to'liq band qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Barcha joylar sotilgan yoki band qilingan.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to catch the bus.
cards.exUz: Agar avtobusga yetib olmoqchi bo'lsak, shoshilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq harakat qilish yoki shoshilish.

cards.ex: We had a stopover in Singapore on our way to Australia.
cards.exUz: Avstraliyaga ketayotganda Singapurda oraliq to'xtashimiz bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatning bir qismi sifatida qisqa vaqtga to'xtash.

cards.ex: Luckily, we had roadside assistance when our car broke down.
cards.exUz: Yaxshiyamki, mashinamiz buzilib qolganda yo'l yordami xizmatimiz bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yo'lda buzilib qolgan avtomobillarga ko'rsatiladigan xizmat.

cards.ex: We booked a car rental for our vacation.
cards.exUz: Ta'tilimiz uchun mashina ijaraga oldik.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobilni qisqa muddatga ijaraga olish.

cards.ex: It took me a while to get the hang of driving on the left side of the road.
cards.exUz: Yo'lning chap tomonida haydashni o'rganib olishimga biroz vaqt ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani qanday qilishni tushunib yetmoq.

cards.ex: I always try to get a window seat on flights.
cards.exUz: Men doim reyslarda deraza yonidagi joyni olishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasida deraza yonidagi o'rindiq.

cards.ex: She prefers the aisle seat so she can get up easily.
cards.exUz: U oson turishi uchun yo'lak yonidagi joyni afzal ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Transport vositasida yo'lak yonidagi o'rindiq.

cards.ex: Don't forget to bring your travel documents.
cards.exUz: Sayohat hujjatlaringizni olib kelishni unutmang.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilish uchun zarur bo'lgan hujjatlar.

cards.ex: We decided to book a package tour to Italy.
cards.exUz: Biz Italiyaga tayyor sayohat buyurtma qilishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Barcha xizmatlarni (mehmonxona, transport va h.k.) o'z ichiga olgan sayohat.

cards.ex: We love exploring places off the beaten track.
cards.exUz: Biz odam oyoq bosmagan joylarni o'rganishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur sayyohlik yo'nalishlaridan uzoqda bo'lgan joy.

cards.ex: The flight attendant showed me where the emergency exits were.
cards.exUz: Styuardessa menga favqulodda chiqish joylarini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Samolyotda yo'lovchilarga xizmat ko'rsatadigan xodim.

cards.ex: I bought some perfume at the duty-free shop.
cards.exUz: Men boj olinmaydigan do'kondan atir sotib oldim.
cards.uzDef: Aeroport yoki portda boj olinmaydigan tovarlar sotiladigan do'kon.

cards.ex: You can hop on and hop off the bus at any of the stops.
cards.exUz: Avtobusning har qanday bekatida sakrab chiqib, sakrab tushishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tezda transportga kirish/chiqish.

cards.ex: Long-haul flights can be very tiring.
cards.exUz: Uzoq reyslar juda charchatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq masofaga uchadigan reys.

cards.ex: I had to clean the windshield before I started driving.
cards.exUz: Haydashni boshlashimdan oldin old oynani tozalashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Avtomobilning old o'rindig'idagi oyna.

cards.ex: If I win the lottery, I'm going to travel in style from now on!
cards.exUz: Agar lotereyada yutsam, bundan buyon hashamatli sayohat qilaman!
cards.uzDef: Qulay va hashamatli sharoitlarda sayohat qilish, yuqori darajada sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: We didn't book any hotels, we're just winging it on our trip through Europe.
cards.exUz: Biz hech qanday mehmonxona bron qilmadik, biz Yevropa bo'ylab sayohatimizda shunchaki tayyorgarliksiz ketyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmasdan, o'z holiga tashlab sayohat qilish yoki ish qilish.

cards.ex: Forget the Eiffel Tower, I want to explore local gems when I visit Paris.
cards.exUz: Eyfel minorasini unut, men Parijga borganimda mahalliy durdonalarni o'rganmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat davomida mashhur bo'lmagan, lekin qiziqarli joylarni kashf qilish.
